gloss: to shave, to plane, to whittle; to cut, to reduce

definitions.gloss: to shave, to plane, to whittle
definitions.explanation: To remove thin layers from a surface, especially wood.
To make a pencil point sharp by removing wood.

definitions.gloss: to cut, to reduce, to delete
definitions.explanation: To reduce or remove something, such as a budget or text.

examples.japanese: {予算|よさん}を{削|けず}られた。
{鰹節|かつおぶし}を{削|けず}って{使|つか}う。
examples.english: Shave dried bonito and use it.

notes:
{削|けず}る means to shave, scrape, or cut away material from a surface.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
- Pair: {削|けず}れる (intransitive - to be shaved off, to wear away)
- Pattern: Xを{削|けず}る

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {鉛筆|えんぴつ}を{削|けず}る (to sharpen a pencil)
- {予算|よさん}を{削|けず}る (to cut a budget)
- {文章|ぶんしょう}を{削|けず}る (to cut/edit text)
- {鰹節|かつおぶし}を{削|けず}る (to shave dried bonito)
- {身|み}を{削|けず}る (to work extremely hard, lit: to shave one's body)

RELATED VOCABULARY:
- {削減|さくげん}する (to reduce, to cut - formal)
- {彫|ほ}る (to carve, to sculpt)
